description: Replace a listing's quick answers (the questions buyers ask, answered by the maker): up to 6, each a question of 8–140 characters and an answer of 2–600. An empty list removes them. On a live listing, answers that add a link or are mostly rewritten wait for review. Needs listings:write.

answers.description: The full list (it replaces the old one); empty removes them all.

name: set_quick_answers
title: Set a listing's quick answers
